subject: bench
name: 长椅
label: 圆角小长椅
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. A simple rounded wooden bench front view, seat, backrest and two sturdy legs.
Very simple coloring-book contour drawing. One smooth blank backrest, one flat blank seat, and two plain block legs. Draw only these outlines using black ink. All surfaces have no marks at all: no wood grain, no shading, no gray tones or fills. Make the whole bench gently rounded, friendly and clear, front view.
